subject.title: Add Herdr state bridge for OpenClaw TUI

question: Should Herdr state reporting be accepted as a bundled plugin-gated TUI integration, explicit core-owned TUI behavior, or moved outside core until a generic plugin seam is designed?
rationale: The PR mixes a default-on bundled plugin shell with core env-triggered TUI behavior, and automation cannot choose the permanent owner boundary for a third-party terminal integration.

options.title: Accept as plugin-gated TUI integration
options.body: Keep the feature only if startup is governed by resolved plugin activation policy and live Herdr proof is added.

options.title: Make it explicit core behavior
options.body: Remove the misleading plugin wrapper and document the ambient Herdr env-triggered TUI behavior as core-owned.

options.title: Move it outside core
options.body: Pause or close this PR unless a missing generic TUI/plugin API is identified for an external Herdr package.

recommendation.title: Accept as plugin-gated TUI integration
recommendation.body: Keep the feature only if startup is governed by resolved plugin activation policy and live Herdr proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans product scope, plugin policy, and core TUI ownership, all areas with strong history or explicit routing to steipete.
